info.name: cclu-api
info.description: Manual testing collection for the CCLU API. Every endpoint lives in the folder of the module that owns it. The collection stores no credentials: create a Postman environment of your own and set the variables this collection declares.

item.name: Health
item.description: Service and database reachability. Not part of the domain.

request.description: Returns 200 with "database": "connected" when the API reached MongoDB, and 503 with "database": "disconnected" when the process started but the connection is down.

Answers 204 and sets the session cookie, which Postman keeps in its jar and returns on its own. Invalid credentials always answer 401 with the same message, whether or not the address is an account. Ten failures from one address within fifteen minutes answer 429.

204 and the session cookie when the application is approved and the account active. 401 with one message for a wrong password or an address that is not an account. 403 with a reason once the password was right but the application is pending or rejected, or the account suspended.
Returns the identity behind the session cookie. Postman stores the cookie on sign in and sends it back on its own, so there is nothing to paste here.
Clears the session cookie. Needs no authentication, so an expired session can still be closed.

request.description: Public, since nobody has an account yet. Answers 201 with the identifier alone, and writes to the applicant on the address they registered with. Role and application status are set by the server and ignored if sent. A repeated identifier answers 409 with a message that names nothing. An empresa or an asociación sends the razón social, its legal representative and the personería jurídica; a profesional independiente sends their own name instead.

item.name: Applications
item.description: The three answers a registration can receive. Until the admin screens exist, these requests are how a decision is made: the applicant is told by email, and a rejection or a request for changes hands them a link to send it back.

request.description: What waits for a decision, oldest first, so whoever has waited longest is seen first. Needs an administrator session; the password hash is never part of the answer.
Approved, rejected and asked-for-changes applications, most recent first. Asking for changes is an answer too: the chamber has looked at the application and the next move is the applicant's.

Draws the member code, leaves the account able to sign in and writes the applicant with their code. The code is unique, so a collision is answered by drawing another one. An application that is not pending answers 409 with the state it is in.

Closes the application and tells the applicant why. No member code is drawn: a code is the mark of belonging to the chamber, and a rejected applicant never belonged. The message carries a personal link to correct and send it again.

The answer between approving and rejecting: the application is kept and the applicant is told what to fix. A field outside the list the correction form can show answers 400, because asking for one would send the applicant looking for a field that is not there, and a field named without a reason of its own answers 400 for the same kind of reason. The applicant is told the reason, every field with what is wrong with it, and the link.

item.name: Corrections
item.description: Reached only by the link a rejection or a request for changes carries. Public on purpose: somebody whose registration was refused cannot sign in, so the token in the link is the proof that the application is theirs.

request.description: Every field the applicant may correct, with its stored value, plus the reason, what the chamber said about each field it named, who decided and when, and the address, which the link cannot change. A link that expired, was already used, or belongs to an application that is no longer awaiting the applicant answers 404 with the same message.

request.description: Reads the fields the correction screen shows against the same rules the registration answers to, and sends the application back to pending review. The address, the password, the consents and everything the screen does not show are not read here: they are preserved rather than corrected. A member type and an identification type that do not go together answer 400, and the identity that does not go with the chosen type is cleared. The link is spent on the way out, so sending twice answers 404.
Closed list the registration form offers. Public.
The accepted economic activities the registration form offers. Public. An applicant whose activity is missing writes it out instead, and it joins this list when the chamber approves the registration.

Public, because a registration carries its uploads before the applicant has an account. Answers 201 with the key, which is what the registration sends. The purpose decides the folder: membership-certifications, member-logos or payment-receipts. The owner names the member or administrator the file belongs to; a registration that has no account yet uses the identifier its form generated.
Streams the file. The key is the capability: it carries 256 random bits, so an address that holds one was only ever handed it. Send the whole key percent-encoded, slashes included.
